description: Fix authorization bug in getCandidateReport - remove incorrect candidate role check since candidates authenticate via tokens not user accounts
steps: Remove the isCandidate check from getCandidateReport function in server/src/controllers/report.controller.js around lines 81-84
Update the authorization logic to only allow interviewer access via JWT for the protected candidate-report route
Ensure the public candidate report routes remain unchanged and working
acceptance_criteria: getCandidateReport function only checks for interviewer ownership, not candidate role
Public candidate report routes still work via join tokens
Interviewer can access candidate reports via protected routes
verification: Test GET /api/interviews/:id/candidate-report with interviewer JWT - should return report
Test GET /api/interviews/public/:token/candidate-report with valid token - should return report
Verify no authentication errors for legitimate access patterns
findings: Fixed authorization bug in getCandidateReport and downloadCandidatePdf functions. Removed problematic isCandidate check (req.user.role === 'candidate' && interview.candidate_email === req.user.email) that was blocking legitimate access since candidates authenticate via public routes with join tokens, not JWT user accounts. Now only allows interviewer access via JWT for protected routes, while public candidate routes with tokens remain unchanged and functional.
